payload.content:
Technical Constraints
TC-1: Technology Stack
HTML for structure
CSS for styling
Vanilla JavaScript (no frameworks like React, Vue, etc.)
No backend server required


TC-2: Data Storage
Use browser Local Storage API
All data stored client-side only


TC-3: Browser Compatibility
Must work in modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari)
Can be used as standalone web app or browser extension


Non-Functional Requirements
NFR-1: Simplicity
Clean, minimal interface
Easy to understand and use
No complex setup required
No test setup required


NFR-2: Performance
Fast load time
Responsive UI interactions
No noticeable lag when updating data


NFR-3: Visual Design
User-friendly aesthetic
Clear visual hierarchy
Readable typography




Required Features (MVP)
Your project must include:
Greeting
Show current time and date
Show a greeting based on the time of day
Focus Timer
25-minute timer
Start, stop, and reset buttons
To-Do List
Add tasks
Edit tasks
Mark tasks as done
Delete tasks
Save tasks using Local Storage
Quick Links
Buttons that open favorite websites
Links must be saved in Local Storage

Folder Rules
Only 1 CSS file inside css/
Only 1 JavaScript file inside js/
Keep code clean and readable

GitHub & Deployment (Only basic Git is needed)
Use GitHub Desktop to save your work
Push your code to GitHub
Publish the site using GitHub Pages

‼️Challenges (Choose 3)
Choose 3 out of these 5 options to make your project more interactive and user-friendly:
Light / Dark mode
Custom name in greeting
Change Pomodoro time
Prevent duplicate tasks
Sort tasks

payload.content:
Here's the full requirements audit against what's in the files:

**TC-1: Technology Stack**
- HTML ✅ `index.html`
- CSS ✅ `css/style.css`
- Vanilla JS, no frameworks ✅ `js/app.js` — `'use strict'`, no imports, no libraries

**TC-2: Data Storage**
- LocalStorage API ✅ — `Storage.get/set` wrapping `localStorage` used for tasks, links, name, theme

**TC-3: Browser Compatibility**
- Modern browsers ✅ — uses standard DOM APIs, Web Audio API with fallback, `prefers-color-scheme` media query

**Folder Rules**
- Only 1 CSS file in `css/` ✅ — `style.css`
- Only 1 JS file in `js/` ✅ — `app.js`

**NFR-1/2/3: Simplicity, Performance, Visual Design**
- Clean minimal interface ✅ — Persona 5-inspired palette, Oswald font, clear hierarchy
- No heavy dependencies ✅ — Google Fonts CDN is the only external load
- Fast/responsive ✅ — no framework overhead, CSS transitions only

---

**MVP Features**

| Feature | Requirement | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Greeting | Time-based phrase | ✅ `_getGreetingPhrase()` — morning/afternoon/evening/night |
| Greeting | Current time | ✅ `_formatClock()` live clock with `setInterval` |
| Greeting | Current date | ✅ `_formatDate()` full date string |
| Focus Timer | 25-minute default | ✅ `_totalSeconds = 25 * 60` |
| Focus Timer | Start/Stop/Reset | ✅ three buttons wired up |
| To-Do | Add tasks | ✅ form submit |
| To-Do | Edit tasks | ✅ edit modal |
| To-Do | Mark done | ✅ checkbox toggles `done` state + strikethrough |
| To-Do | Delete tasks | ✅ delete button |
| To-Do | LocalStorage | ✅ `_save()/_load()` on every mutation |
| Quick Links | Open favorite sites | ✅ `<a target="_blank">` buttons |
| Quick Links | LocalStorage | ✅ `_save()/_load()` |

**Challenges (3 chosen)**

| # | Challenge | Status |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Light/Dark mode | ✅ `Theme` module — toggle button, `[data-theme]` on `<html>`, system preference detection, saved to storage |
| 2 | Custom name in greeting | ✅ `Greeting` module — "Set Name" button opens modal, name persisted in storage, falls back to "There" |
| 3 | Prevent duplicate tasks | ✅ `_isDuplicate()` case-insensitive check on add AND edit |

**Bonus (not required but present)**
- Change Pomodoro time — ✅ also included (the "Duration" input + Set button in the timer card, 1–60 min range)
- Sort tasks — ✅ also included (↕ Sort toggle in To-Do header)

That means all 5 challenges are actually implemented, not just 3. The rubric only requires 3, so you're covered and then some.

---

The project is complete and meets every requirement. Your next steps are just the GitHub ones:

```
git add index.html css/style.css js/app.js
git commit -m "Add personal dashboard with timer, todos, quick links, and 3 challenges"
git push
```

Then enable GitHub Pages in your repo settings (Settings → Pages → Branch: `main`, folder: `/ (root)`).
